blog_content:
Making the Right Investment for Your Wedding Journey

After announcing your engagement, one of the first and most pivotal decisions you will make is determining what level of professional event management support you require. In the luxury wedding market, planning packages generally fall into two primary categories: Full-Service Wedding Planning and Month-of Event Planning (often colloquially referred to as wedding day coordination).

Both planning models serve distinct client profiles and wedding formats. Choosing the wrong service model can either lead to unnecessary expenditure or, conversely, leave you overwhelmed with hundreds of hours of logistical vendor management during the most important months of your life.

At Nova Events Co., our team provides both full planning services and dedicated Month of Event Planning across the United States and internationally. Led by Ruby Arora, a PMP-certified event director with over 25 years of global event leadership, here is a transparent guide to help you choose the ideal level of support.

1. What is Full-Service Wedding Planning?

Full-service wedding planning is a comprehensive, white-glove partnership that spans from your initial concept and budget formulation through your post-reception farewell brunch.

Core Services Included:

  • Budget Architecture & Allocation: Establishing realistic budget projections across all categories, preventing surprise cost overruns, and negotiating preferred pricing with premier vendor partners.
  • Venue Scouting & Contract Diligence: Touring prospective ballrooms, historic mansions, or private estates, negotiating outside catering kitchen fees, corkage waivers, and curfew extensions.
  • Creative Design & Styling: Developing customized 3D floor plans, floral mockups, tablescape curation, linen rentals, lighting schematics, and color palettes.
  • Vendor Sourcing & Management: Hand-selecting vetted caterers, photographers, cinematic videographers, hair/makeup artists, and entertainment teams, managing all communication and payment schedules.
  • Guest Hospitality & Bespoke Gifting: Managing hotel room blocks, executive transportation shuttles, and curated welcome hampers through our dedicated gifting division.
  • Master Production & On-Site Coordination: Directing rehearsal walk-throughs, overseeing load-in and load-out, and managing a multi-person planning team on event day.

Who Full-Service is Best For:

  • Busy executives, physicians, entrepreneurs, or couples with demanding professional schedules who have limited time to manage dozens of vendor emails weekly.
  • Couples planning multi-day, cultural, or destination celebrations with 200 to 500+ guests.
  • Couples transforming raw spaces, private residential estates, or open-air marquees that require building complete infrastructure from scratch (generators, luxury restrooms, lighting, flooring).

2. What is Month-of Event Planning?

Month-of Event Planning is designed for couples who enjoy the creative process of selecting their own venue, booking their favorite vendors, and designing their visual aesthetic, but want a seasoned professional to step in, audit the logistics, and execute the event flawlessly.

Core Services Included:

  • Logistical Hand-Off (4 to 6 Weeks Prior): The planning team takes over all vendor contracts, insurance certificates, and operational communication.
  • Timeline & Run-of-Show Architecture: Creating a minute-by-minute master timeline covering vendor arrivals, hair and makeup rotations, photography reveals, processional orders, and reception cues.
  • Final Venue Walk-Through: Meeting on-site with catering directors and production leads to review floor plans, power requirements, and load-in schedules.
  • Rehearsal Direction: Leading your wedding party and family through the ceremony processional, recessional, and seating choreography.
  • Complete Event-Day Execution: Managing vendor arrivals, directing ballroom flips, troubleshooting unexpected challenges, keeping the schedule on time, and packing up personal keepsakes at the end of the evening.

Who Month-of Planning is Best For:

  • Organized couples who have already contracted all their primary vendors and secured an all-inclusive hotel ballroom or full-service venue.
  • Intimate or single-day celebrations with straightforward timelines and limited structural production.
  • Couples seeking professional peace of mind so they, their wedding party, and their parents can be fully present on the wedding day without managing logistics.

Key Comparison: Side-by-Side Breakdown

  • Time Commitment from the Couple: Full Planning requires ~15–25 total hours of decision-making. Month-of Coordination requires 150–250+ hours of personal vendor research and administrative coordination before handing off.
  • Design & Styling Ownership: Full Planning includes custom design boards, CAD layouts, and floral styling. Month-of Coordination focuses purely on executing the design elements you have already sourced.
  • Budget Management: Full Planning actively monitors and optimizes your overall budget from Day 1. Month-of Coordination manages logistics within the contracts you have already executed.

The Value of PMP-Certified Event Leadership

Regardless of whether you choose Full-Service Planning or Month-of Coordination, having a team with formal project management credentials makes all the difference.
